boundaries.title: Professional Boundaries & Ethics
boundaries.description: Aligned with ICF ethical frameworks to ensure safety and data agency.

items.question: Who controls the data?
items.answer: You retain full agency over shared information. No details are shared with employers or third-party HR without your explicit written consent.

items.question: Is medical or legal advice included?
items.answer: Coaching is not a replacement for therapy or legal services. We will signpost appropriate professionals and pause coaching if needs fall outside our scope.

items.question: Handling external over-capacity?
items.answer: We evaluate risks together. We offer a 'pause clause' to suspend work during high-pressure periods and resume when conditions allow.

cases.title: Anonymised Case Studies
cases.description: Composite scenarios demonstrating diverse professional re-entry pathways.

items.title: Flexible Working Negotiation
items.context: A senior manager returning after a 2-year break, needing to balance care duties with role demands.
items.coaching_moves: Identified non-negotiable needs, drafted outreach scripts based on 'output alignment', and rehearsed a phased re-entry proposal.
items.shift: Secured a 4-day working pattern and established a formal 'health review rhythm' with the line manager.

items.title: Structured Return post-burnout
items.context: A project lead returning after burnout leave, concerned about maintaining a sustainable pace.
items.coaching_moves: Established energy auditing rituals, practiced evidence-based support requests, and defined monitoring cadences for the first 90 days.
items.shift: Shifted communication from 'defensive bracing' to 'proactive capacity management' based on visible data points.

items.q: How does coaching differ from recruitment?
items.a: Recruitment focuses on the transaction of a placement. Coaching focuses on your 'long-term fit and resilience', building skills that last beyond a single role.
We do not provide placement guarantees. Our value lies in significantly improving your market positioning and decision-making clarity.

items.q: What is the level of confidentiality?
items.a: We follow ICF Code of Ethics. Confidentiality is strictly maintained except where legal disclosure is mandated by law (safeguarding).

items.q: How does coaching differ from a recruitment agency?
items.a: Recruiters are paid by employers to fill a seat. We are paid by you to build your long-term professional resilience. Our goal is to develop your strategic evaluation skills so you can independently navigate the entire market.

checklist: Understands coaching as a collaborative partnership, not a passive advice-reception.
Comfortable with behavioral experiments where failure is viewed as a data point.
Workable within UK office hours (GMT/BST) for online sessions.
